retrieval_contract.reason: Provide ZTF-local PSF context without changing sky coordinate or epoch.

ztf_local_sensitivity_gate.native_psf_estimator: estimate_native_psf_fwhm on the expanded same-epoch science frame
ztf_local_sensitivity_gate.minimum_native_psf_reference_behavior: If no native PSF estimate can be formed, the epoch remains BLOCKED_NATIVE_PSF_REFERENCE.
ztf_local_sensitivity_gate.target_measurement: measure_psf_at at the frozen WCS coordinate before any injection

edge_gate.reason: Allow an edge-aware local gate only when the modeled PSF is effectively contained and the unchanged detector can measure it.

trial_classification.ISOLATED_B_L0: A QUALIFIED_ABSENCE, B SOURCE_PRESENT, C QUALIFIED_ABSENCE

scientific_success.PASS_ALL_28_NULL: All eight formerly unresolved trials become NO_ISOLATED_B_EVENT, zero candidates, zero nonisolated patterns; combined parent+recovery qualified null count becomes 28/28.
scientific_success.CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_ADJUDICATION: At least one recovered trial becomes ISOLATED_B_L0.
scientific_success.BLOCKED_RECOVERY_INCOMPLETE: At least one of the eight remains unresolved or becomes nonisolated.

not_admitted: No weakening or retrospective reinterpretation of the twenty parent qualified null trials.
No replacement of a frozen A/B/C epoch with a more favorable exposure.
No global rejection of optical transients.
No physical tachyon identification, faster-than-light propagation, retrocausality, UAP origin, artificial origin, ETI, or nuclear causality claim.
